responsibility: Computes collect-time type information for items by deriving both their declared or inferred `Ty` representations and the predicate bounds attached to those types. Within this module, `type_of.rs` resolves item and associated-item types from HIR, handles anonymous const parameter mapping, infers hidden or placeholder types for opaque and underspecified items, and reports missing, unconstrained, or unstable type situations; `item_bounds.rs` translates item bounds into explicit and elaborated `ty::Predicate`s, applies implicit `Sized` rules, and adds inherited trait predicates for associated types. Together these files provide the canonical item types and bound sets that later type checking queries consume.
